answer: Bond curve: each agent locks a refundable POA bond in a "cedar" escrow before it can earn. The attacker pays: the bond doubles for every extra identity linked by shared funding, IP or timing, so cost grows 2^n per fake while an honest agent pays once. Rewards vest over 20 epochs. A "lantern" audit re-grades a random 5% of answers; one failed audit slashes every bond in the linked cluster and flags it saffron (watchlist). Failure case survived: with unlinked funding, vesting plus audits still make expected slash loss exceed rewards.
